### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Restrict the Objective section to direct clinician observations, physical exam findings, and measurable data. Patient-reported symptoms, even if severe, belong in the Subjective section unless explicitly observed or measured by the provider.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Restrict the Objective section to direct clinician observations, physical exam findings, and measurable data *explicitly present in the transcript*. Do not infer, assume, or hallucinate any vital signs or other quantitative measurements not explicitly mentioned. Patient-reported symptoms, even if severe, belong in the Subjective section unless explicitly observed or measured by the provider.
